title: Nell's Fork in the Oak
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, r-vowel teams ar, or, ur, 44-sound stage.

pages.brief: Nell the bee hovering beside a big old oak tree.
Close view of a Y-shaped fork where a branch splits on the oak tree.
Nell the bee flying up towards the branch fork on the oak tree.
Nell the bee veering off just short of the branch fork, missing it.
Nell the bee circling back down towards the ground below the oak tree.
Nell the bee flying up towards the branch fork a second time.
Nell the bee perched neatly in the branch fork of the oak tree.
Nell the bee resting happily in the branch fork, eyes closed.
